matches.rationale: Finding 1 directly targets Case 2.1 of the correctness analysis and argues that the claim 'if s ∈ A then BFS⁺(s) finds a triangle' is unproven/false because b and c may have different BFS parents, meaning the algorithm does not always succeed as the proof assumes. This matches the ground truth's description of a faulty assumption that the algorithm always succeeds under certain conditions.
